text.description_html:
Acorn RP8BP, Ancient King Rough Iron Ring Pull

Made from cast iron, Acorn's RP8BP Ancient King Rough Iron Ring Pull mimics the rough texture inherent to natural weathering of iron. It is designed for lightweight doors. This pull gives an old world charm to any home or garden gate because the design at the top is not unlike the pattern found on the fabric of royalty centuries ago. Rather than a traditional larger rod pull, this unique detailing will make your outdoor space special. It's also great when you don't want a door pull to be so obvious, this small iron ring can easily blend in with an outside garden or atrium.

Features of the Acorn Ancient King Door Pull Ring:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 3-1/4"
  • Width: 3-7/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/4"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
